flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — P/E 40, P/B 5.5, DCF overvalued 48%. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.title: Turnaround vs. sentiment
flags.note: Results are improving (results score 84/100, net profit +89% YoY) while the price/verdict stays cautious. Don't dismiss a turnaround on stale sentiment.
flags.lesson: Union Bank: sold the 'dull PSU' near the bottom (about ₹48), missed the re-rating to ₹140+.
